---
title: "Top 30 vOTUs prevalence and CPM"
output: html_document
date: "2025-11-22"
---

```{r}
# FIGURE 2E

library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

# Load data
df <- read_csv(
  here("data", "results_with_metadata.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Create timepoint labels
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_label = case_when(
      mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 0.25 ~ "1 Week Infant",
      mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 1    ~ "1 Month Infant",
      mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 6    ~ "6 Months Infant",
      mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 12   ~ "12 Months Infant",
      mother_infant == "mother" & bodysite == "stool"      ~ "Mothers",
      bodysite == "breastmilk"                             ~ "Breastmilk",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    timepoint_label = factor(
      timepoint_label,
      levels = c(
        "1 Week Infant",
        "1 Month Infant",
        "6 Months Infant",
        "12 Months Infant",
        "Mothers",
        "Breastmilk"
      )
    ),
    CPM = as.numeric(CPM)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(timepoint_label))

# Clean host genus
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Host.genus_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(as.character(Host.genus), "g__") ~
        str_remove(
          str_extract(as.character(Host.genus), "g__[^;]+"),
          "^g__"
        ),
      !is.na(Host.genus) & Host.genus != "" ~ as.character(Host.genus),
      TRUE ~ "Unclassified"
    ),
    Host.label = Host.genus_clean
  )

# Timepoint colors
timepoint_colors <- c(
  "1 Week Infant"    = "blue",
  "1 Month Infant"   = "darkgreen",
  "6 Months Infant"  = "mediumaquamarine",
  "12 Months Infant" = "gold",
  "Mothers"           = "purple4",
  "Breastmilk"        = "pink"
)

# Select the 30 most abundant vOTUs globally by total CPM
top30_tbl <- df %>%
  filter(CPM > 0) %>%
  group_by(vOTUs) %>%
  summarise(
    total_CPM = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    df %>%
      select(vOTUs, Host.label) %>%
      distinct(vOTUs, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = "vOTUs"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(vOTUs, " (", Host.label, ")")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_CPM)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 30)

# IDs of the 30 most abundant vOTUs
top30_ids <- top30_tbl$vOTUs

# Order vOTUs by total CPM
# Lowest factor level first so the highest CPM appears at the top
orden_por_CPM <- top30_tbl %>%
  arrange(total_CPM) %>%
  pull(label)

# Calculate prevalence for the same 30 vOTUs by timepoint
votu_individuos_tp <- df %>%
  filter(
    vOTUs %in% top30_ids,
    CPM > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(vOTUs, timepoint_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_individuos = n_distinct(subject),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    top30_tbl %>%
      select(vOTUs, label, total_CPM),
    by = "vOTUs"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = factor(label, levels = orden_por_CPM)
  )

# Calculate total CPM for the same 30 vOTUs by timepoint
votu_CPM_tp <- df %>%
  filter(
    vOTUs %in% top30_ids,
    CPM > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(vOTUs, timepoint_label) %>%
  summarise(
    total_CPM_tp = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    top30_tbl %>%
      select(vOTUs, label, total_CPM),
    by = "vOTUs"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = factor(label, levels = orden_por_CPM)
  )

# Prevalence panel
P_prev <- ggplot(
  votu_individuos_tp,
  aes(
    x = n_individuos,
    y = label,
    fill = timepoint_label
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = timepoint_colors,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of individuals",
    y = "vOTU (Host genus)",
    fill = "Timepoint"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# CPM panel
P_cpm <- ggplot(
  votu_CPM_tp,
  aes(
    x = total_CPM_tp,
    y = label,
    fill = timepoint_label
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = timepoint_colors,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = comma
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Total CPM",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Timepoint"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Combine both panels side by side
FIG_COMBINED <- P_prev + P_cpm +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(1, 1),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Show figure
print(FIG_COMBINED)

# Create output directory
out_dir <- here("results", "figures", "vOTUs")

dir.create(
  out_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Save figure
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    out_dir,
    "Top30_vOTUs_CPM_prevalence.png"
  ),
  plot = FIG_COMBINED,
  width = 14,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    out_dir,
    "Top30_vOTUs_CPM_prevalence.pdf"
  ),
  plot = FIG_COMBINED,
  width = 14,
  height = 8
)

# Save table with the selected vOTUs
write_csv(
  top30_tbl,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "Top30_vOTUs_by_total_CPM.csv"
  )
)
```
